# neurons: High performance modeling tools in C++ with R interface

Neurons is an R/C++ package for simulating neurons and networks of
neurons, currently under development at [Oviedo
Lab](https://oviedolab.org/). The package is built around a few core
object classes, all of which are a C++ class accessible through R via
Rcpp modules and wrappers.

- **neuron**: For modeling the spiking of single neurons with
  dichotomized Gaussians.
- **network**: For simulating spiking neural networks with
  Growth-transform dynamical systems.
- **motif**: For specifying general patterns of connectivity between
  neurons in a circuit, i.e., a “circuit motif” or “network topology”.

![Artistic rendering of a neuron](reference/figures/neurons_package.png)

Copyright (C) 2025, Michael Barkasi <barkasi@wustl.edu>

# Package index

## Initialization functions

- [`new.motif()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/new.motif.md)
  : Initialize network (circuit) motif
- [`new.network()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/new.network.md)
  : Initialize neuron network

## Motif method wrappers

- [`load.projection.into.motif()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/load.projection.into.motif.md)
  : Load projection into motif

## Network method wrappers

- [`set.network.structure()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/set.network.structure.md)
  : Set network structure
- [`fetch.network.components()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/fetch.network.components.md)
  : Fetch network components
- [`apply.circuit.motif()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/apply.circuit.motif.md)
  : Apply circuit motif to network
- [`run.SGT()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/run.SGT.md)
  : Run Spatial Growth-Transform network simulation
- [`plot.network()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/plot-network.md)
  : Plot network as directed graph
- [`plot.network.traces()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/plot-network-traces.md)
  : Plot spike traces for network from SGT simulation

## Network cell type functions

- [`print.known.celltypes()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/print-known-celltypes.md)
  : Print known cell types
- [`fetch.cell.type.params()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/fetch.cell.type.params.md)
  : Fetch cell type parameters
- [`add.cell.type()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/add.cell.type.md)
  : Add new cell type
- [`modify.cell.type()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/modify.cell.type.md)
  : Modify existing cell type
- [`principal.neurons()`](https://Oviedo-Lab.github.io/DACx/reference/principal.neurons.md)
  : Return principal neurons by standard layers
